content: hi! i've formalized confluence and exact win probabilities for Elevens solitaire in Lean 4 using native_decide. the main result is that the game's outcome is entirely determined by the initial shuffle. i'm looking for an arXiv cs.LO endorser for a short paper (~11 pages). happy to share the draft. (this is my first arXiv submission.)
